topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: Old John's come askin’ about puttin’ up a fence, and I can't help but think of the times we’ve shared the bounty of the land, like good neighbors ought. I reckoned his sheep have wandered a bit, trampling the edges of his field, and maybe mine too. But fences, they keep things apart, don’t they? I told him I’d think on it, but I’ve walked these paths with him, and seen the good in his heart. Perhaps a word or two about watchin’ the flock closer might serve us both better than hammering nails and sinking posts. I’ll speak with him again, maybe offer a hand with his sheep, show him I’d rather keep the peace and the land open, as it’s always been.
